remaining_limitations: The reported PhalaCloud/GLM-5.3-W4AFP8 weights were not available.
The assigned hardware is one AMD gfx950 GPU, while the report requires eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs, CUDA FlashMLA, TP=8, DP=2, disaggregated decode, Mooncake, and InfiniBand.

Therefore the full model, FlashMLA kernel invocation, disaggregation transport, and multi-node/multi-GPU behavior remain unverified; the result is a source-level candidate verified by a failing-before/passing-after shape regression and the shared production padding path on gfx950.
No native library was changed or rebuilt.
